decisionUnit: additional participant no longer meeting the study's loneliness threshold at six months

bottomLine.interpretation: Our best guess is roughly $15,000 per additional participant no longer meeting the study's loneliness threshold at six months, with a deliberately wide $5,000–$78,000 range. This is an exploratory decision model, not a measured IOA result or a recommendation.

formula.rangeMethod: optimistic = low cost / high effect; pessimistic = high cost / low effect

inputs.label: Illustrative gift
inputs.basis: Donor scenario, not published funding room

inputs.label: Proactive calls over six months
inputs.basis: MFI operating assumption of two calls per week; IOA does not publish a common dose for the pilot or current participants

inputs.label: Staff or volunteer time per call including notes
inputs.basis: MFI operating assumption; no IOA time-and-motion study located

inputs.label: Loaded program resource cost
inputs.basis: MFI blended assumption for supervision, paid staff, volunteer management, technology, training, and overhead—not an IOA reported wage

inputs.label: Six-month marginal cost per proactive participant
inputs.basis: Bottom-up synthesis of call dose, time, loaded resource cost, and a modest non-call allowance; not reconciled to program accounts

inputs.label: Observed decline in participants reporting loneliness
inputs.basis: 46% at baseline to 28% at six months in the 121-person single-group pilot
inputs.confidence: moderate for the enrolled sample; not causal

inputs.label: MFI estimate of causal six-month remission per participant
inputs.basis: Judgmental 39% attribution of the observed 18-point within-participant decline, with a 2–12 point range for regression to the mean, secular change, selection, and missing counterfactual

excludedBenefits: Suicides averted, because no program-specific counterfactual suicide effect was located
Emergency visits or healthcare spending averted, because participant anecdotes are not utilization estimates
Mortality, QALY, WELLBY, or life-substantially-bettered conversions
Benefits from inbound crisis calls, grief groups, referrals, or other IOA programs

fundingRoom.boundary: The $100,000 gift is an illustrative denominator, not a claim that IOA can productively absorb it for incremental proactive calls. A recommendation requires a dated marginal plan, program accounts, staffing and volunteer capacity, payer restrictions, and evidence that a private gift would add rather than displace calls.
fundingRoom.requiredNext: Obtain an IOA-approved six-month proactive-call budget and capacity plan at $100K, $1M, and $10M, then replace every MFI cost assumption with program accounts and rerun the sensitivity analysis.
